profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
At the core of my professional ethos is the belief that technology must serve a purpose, streamlining operations or enhancing enterprise value. With a focus on SaaS and proficiency in Agile methodologies, my role as a Full-Stack Developer at TEKsystems has centered around transforming outdated systems into efficient, modern solutions. We specialize in Angular and .Net frameworks to create robust applications, like the health plan documentation tool for nurses.

The journey at Queryon honed my consultative skills, guiding customer interactions to distill complex requirements into actionable software strategies. Our team's collaborative efforts in developing a trucking integration system exemplified the power of aligning business objectives with technological execution. This blend of strategic acumen and technical expertise is the cornerstone of my contribution to the industry, ensuring software is not just built, but thoughtfully engineered to solve the right problems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Led design and development of scalable enterprise applications across multiple client engagements, leveraging C#, .NET 8, Blazor, and TypeScript.
    • Transformed legacy Power Apps and Power Automate solutions into robust web applications, improving global stability and user experience.
    • Architected and modernized API platforms, implementing factory design patterns to support multiple data providers and improve system flexibility.
    • Designed and deployed Azure-based infrastructure (App Services, Functions, Key Vault, Azure SQL) in compliance with enterprise security standards.
    • Built and integrated secure document workflows using Adobe Sign (QES), reducing processing time from days to minutes.
    • Implemented centralized error logging and monitoring using Azure Application Insights, enabling proactive alerting and improved system reliability.
    • Optimized SQL Server performance through redesigned views and stored procedures supporting high-performance APIs. Developed automated database deployment tooling (PowerShell + DACPAC), eliminating manual environment setup for developers.
    • Created Mockoon framework for testing APIs.  Saving days of delays attempting to get test data from external providers
    • Provided technical leadership on cross-team initiatives, including Azure DevOps consolidation efforts that reduced infrastructure costs and improved operational efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
I worked with customers and the development team to define software solutions to their business problems.  Designed and created an integration with Stripe payment systems API to create invoices, store customer payment information, invoice review, and trigger payments.
•	Excelled in relational database design and implementation on SQL Server.
•	Developed web front-end in Blazor, HTML and CSS and Syncfusion UI controls.
•	Developed back-end using C#
•	Data was managed using code-first approach on Entity Framework Core.
•	Created new RESTful API endpoints in C#.
•	Wrote Azure function to automate monthly billing in Stripe.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Agile Methodologies · Data Structures · C# · Software Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · HTML5 · Requirements Analysis · Data Analysis · Git · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Blazor · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Language Integrated Query (LINQ)

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Vergent LMS is a SaaS loan management system used to manage loans from initiation to close.
•	Developed web front-end in VB.Net web forms, HTML, CSS, .Net Core and Angular 2.  
•	Developed back end using C# and VB.
•	Managed data and data structures using EF Core.
•	Created new API endpoints in C# and JSON
•	Contributed software engineering expertise in the development of products through the software lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements definition through successful deployment.
•	Excelled in relational database design and implementation on MySql (Maria DB).
•	Troubleshooting code using Visual Studio, Postman and Swagger.
•	Participated in Agile software development process.

positions.title: Product Development Program Manager
positions.description:
Technologies: SAAS, MS Project Online, SharePoint, Power BI, MS Flow, SQL Server 2016
Responsible for all projects impacting the software development that have been assigned to the PMO, as well as actively managing SAAS projects.
• Maintained and developed new features for a C# program to update data in MS Project Online.
• Developed a project intake process to evaluate scope, impact and ROI of projects using SharePoint and MS Project.
• Developed executive reporting in Power BI combining MS Project and SharePoint data for project status, PMO intake and resource management.
